drivingQuestion: What counts as a plague of pestilence
outcomeNote: a lemma and a parallel baraita, no argument within this unit

segments.he: אִי זוֹ הִיא דֶּבֶר — עִיר הַמּוֹצִיאָה חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת רַגְלִי כּוּ׳. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: עִיר הַמּוֹצִיאָה חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת וְאֶלֶף רַגְלִי, כְּגוֹן כְּפַר עַכּוֹ, וְיָצְאוּ הֵימֶנָּה תִּשְׁעָה מֵתִים בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה יָמִים זֶה אַחַר זֶה — הֲרֵי זֶה דֶּבֶר.
segments.en: § The mishna taught: «What is» considered a plague of «pestilence?» If it is «a city that sends out five hundred infantrymen,» and three dead are removed from it on three consecutive days, one dead per day, this is a plague of pestilence. «The Sages taught:» If «a city that sends out fifteen hundred infantrymen,» i.e., one that has a population of at least fifteen hundred men, e.g., «the village of Akko, and nine dead are removed from it on three consecutive days,» i.e., three dead per day, «this is» considered a plague of «pestilence.»
